title: Rental Property Service Contracts Returned-Payment Fee Amount
content:
**Fee rule.** The fee billed for the most recent returned premium payment on a Rental Property Service Contracts contract, when that payment was billed back without its returned-payment fee, is the tier's returned-payment fee, billed in full and rounded to the cent. It is billed as one returned-payment fee charge naming that payment.

**Which payment.** The most recent returned premium payment is the latest returned payment charge billed back in the contract's billing history; that charge names the payment by its payment confirmation number, and the fee charge names the same number.

**The figure.** The tier's returned-payment fee is the figure on the product's payment and renewal timing schedule for the contract's tier.

## Illustrations (hypothetical contracts)

| Contract tier | Tier's returned-payment fee | Fee billed |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | $25.00 | **$25.00** |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | $25.00 | **$25.00** |

A contract whose billing history shows two returned payment charges, in March and in August, takes its fee for the August payment, the most recent; the fee charge names the August payment's confirmation number.
